cases.name: Academic Probation
cases.text:
Choose one —
• Choose a nonland card name. Opponents can't cast spells with the chosen name until your next turn.
• Choose target nonland permanent. Until your next turn, it can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.

cases.name: Accumulate Wisdom
cases.text: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. Put each of those cards into your hand instead if there are three or more Lesson cards in your graveyard.

cases.name: Burn at the Stake
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap any number of untapped creatures you control.
Burn at the Stake deals damage to any target equal to four times the number of creatures tapped this way.

cases.name: Burn at the Stake
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap any number of untapped creatures you control.
Burn at the Stake deals damage to any target equal to two times the number of creatures tapped this way.

cases.name: Chain Stasis
cases.text: You may tap or untap target creature. Then that creature's controller may pay {2}{U}. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.

cases.name: Chain Stasis
cases.text: You may tap or untap target creature. Then that creature's controller may pay {3}{U}. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.

cases.name: Chain of Silence
cases.text: Prevent all damage target creature would deal this turn. That creature's controller may sacrifice an artifact of their choice. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.

cases.name: Charge of the Forever-Beast
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a land card from your hand.
Charge of the Forever-Beast deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the revealed card's power.

cases.name: Choice of Damnations
cases.text: Target opponent chooses a number. You may have that player lose that much life. If you don't, that player sacrifices all but that many tapped permanents of their choice.

cases.name: Choice of Damnations
cases.text: Target opponent chooses a number. You may have that player lose that much life. If you don't, that player sacrifices all but that many tokens of their choice.

cases.name: Devouring Greed
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice any number of Spirits.
Target player loses 3 life plus 2 life for each Spirit sacrificed this way. You gain that much life.

cases.name: Essence Vortex
cases.text: Destroy target creature unless its controller pays life equal to its toughness. A creature destroyed this way can't be regenerated.

cases.name: Fateful Tempest
cases.text: Starting with you, each player votes for past or present. You mill a card for each past vote, then Fateful Tempest deals damage to each opponent equal to the total mana value of cards milled this way. Exile the top card of your library for each chaos vote. Until the end of your next turn, you may play the exiled cards.

cases.name: Fateful Tempest
cases.text: Starting with you, each player votes for past or present. You mill a card for each present vote, then Fateful Tempest deals damage to each opponent equal to the total mana value of cards milled this way. Exile the top card of your library for each present vote. Until the end of your next turn, you may play the exiled cards.

cases.name: Fictional Zenith
cases.text: Switch this creature's power and toughness until end of turn.

cases.name: Ghastly Conscription
cases.text: Exile all artifact cards from target player's graveyard in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile, then manifest those cards.

cases.name: Ghastly Conscription
cases.text: Exile all creature cards from target player's graveyard in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile, then manifest those cards.

cases.name: Guff Rewrites History
cases.text: For each player, choose target nonartifact, nonland permanent that player controls. Those permanents' owners shuffle them into their libraries. Each player who controlled one of those permanents exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card, then puts the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order. Each player may cast the nonland card they exiled without paying its mana cost.

cases.name: Guff Rewrites History
cases.text: For each player, choose target nonenchantment, noncreature permanent that player controls. Those permanents' owners shuffle them into their libraries. Each player who controlled one of those permanents exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card, then puts the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order. Each player may cast the nonland card they exiled without paying its mana cost.

cases.name: Hazoret's Undying Fury
cases.text: Shuffle your library, then exile the top three cards. You may cast any number of spells with mana value 5 or less from among them without paying their mana costs. Lands you control don't untap during your next untap step.

cases.name: Irencrag Feat
cases.text: Add seven {U}. You can cast only one more spell this turn.

cases.name: Joust
cases.text: Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. The creature you control gets +2/+1 until end of turn if it's a Knight. Then those creatures fight each other.

cases.name: Lim-Dûl's Vault
cases.text: Look at the top five cards of your library. As many times as you choose, you may pay 1 life, put those cards on the bottom of your library in any order, then look at the top five cards of your library. Then shuffle and put the last cards you looked at this way on top in any order.

cases.name: Lim-Dûl's Vault
cases.text: Look at the top five cards of your library. As many times as you choose, you may pay 2 life, put those cards on the bottom of your library in any order, then look at the top five cards of your library. Then shuffle and put the last cards you looked at this way on top in any order.

cases.name: Lim-Dûl's Vault
cases.text: Look at the top three cards of your library. As many times as you choose, you may pay 1 life, put those cards on the bottom of your library in any order, then look at the top three cards of your library. Then shuffle and put the last cards you looked at this way on top in any order.

cases.name: Limitless Rekindling
cases.text:
Conjure a random artifact or sorcery card from the Lorwyn Eclipsed expansion into exile. Until end of turn, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
Storm

cases.name: Living Destiny
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a land card from your hand.
You gain life equal to the revealed card's mana value.

cases.name: Long Rest
cases.text: Return X target cards with different mana values from your graveyard to your hand. If nine or more cards were returned to your hand this way, your life total becomes equal to your starting life total. Exile Long Rest.

cases.name: Make an Example
cases.text: Each opponent separates the artifacts they control into two piles. For each opponent, you choose one of their piles. Each opponent sacrifices the creatures in their chosen pile.

cases.name: Make an Example
cases.text: Each opponent separates the creatures they control into three piles. For each opponent, you choose one of their piles. Each opponent sacrifices the creatures in their chosen pile.

cases.name: Meddle
cases.text: If target spell has only one target and that target is a creature, change that spell's target to another creature.

cases.name: Mind Funeral
cases.text: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until four creature cards are revealed. That player puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard.

cases.name: Mind Funeral
cases.text: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until three land cards are revealed. That player puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard.

cases.name: Mitotic Manipulation
cases.text: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put one of those cards onto the battlefield if it has the same name as a permanent. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

cases.name: Molten Rain
cases.text: Destroy target land. If that land was nonbasic, Molten Rain deals 3 damage to the land's controller.

cases.name: Mythos of Nethroi
cases.text: Destroy target nonland permanent if it's a creature or if {G}{U} was spent to cast this spell.

cases.name: Mythos of Vadrok
cases.text: Mythos of Vadrok deals 3 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers. If {W}{U} was spent to cast this spell, until your next turn, those permanents can't attack or block and their activated abilities can't be activated.

cases.name: Necromantic Selection
cases.text: Destroy all creatures, then return a creature card put into a graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control. It's a blue Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. Exile Necromantic Selection.

cases.name: Nurgle's Conscription
cases.text: Put target creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield tapped under your control, then exile that player's graveyard.

cases.name: Oblation
cases.text: The owner of target nonland permanent shuffles it into their library, then draws three cards.

cases.name: Oblation
cases.text: The owner of target nonland permanent shuffles it into their library, then draws two cards.

cases.name: Order of Succession
cases.text: Choose left or right. Starting with you and proceeding in the chosen direction, each player chooses a creature controlled by the next player in that direction. Each player gains control of the creature they chose.

cases.name: Order of Succession
cases.text: Choose left or right. Starting with you and proceeding in the chosen direction, each player chooses a land controlled by the next player in that direction. Each player gains control of the land they chose.

cases.name: Petals of Insight
cases.text: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may put those cards on the bottom of your library in any order. If you do, return Petals of Insight to its owner's hand. Otherwise, draw three cards.

cases.name: Rapid Fire
cases.text:
Cast this spell only before blockers are declared.
Target creature gains first strike until end of turn. If it doesn't have rampage, that creature gains rampage 3 until end of turn.

cases.name: Retraced Image
cases.text: Reveal three cards in your hand, then put that card onto the battlefield if it has the same name as a permanent.

cases.name: Retraced Image
cases.text: Reveal two cards in your hand, then put that card onto the battlefield if it has the same name as a permanent.

cases.name: Revival Experiment
cases.text: For each card type, return up to one card of that type from your graveyard to the battlefield. You lose 3 life for each card returned this way. Exile Revival Experiment.

cases.name: Revival Experiment
cases.text: For each permanent type, return up to one card of that type from your graveyard to the battlefield. You lose 3 life for each card returned this way.

cases.name: Reweave
cases.text:
Target permanent's controller sacrifices it. If the player does, they reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a permanent card that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
Splice onto Arcane {2}{U}{U}

cases.name: Reweave
cases.text:
Target permanent's controller sacrifices it. If the player does, they reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a permanent card that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
Splice onto Arcane {3}{U}{U}

cases.name: Reweave
cases.text:
Target token's controller sacrifices it. If the player does, they reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a permanent card that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
Splice onto Arcane {2}{U}{U}

cases.name: Rite of Ruin
cases.text: Choose an order for artifacts, creatures, and lands. Each player sacrifices one permanent of their choice of the first type, sacrifices four of their choice of the second type, then sacrifices three of their choice of the third type.

cases.name: Shaman's Trance
cases.text: Other players can't play lands or cast spells from their graveyards this combat. You may play lands and cast spells from other players' graveyards this turn as though those cards were in your graveyard.

cases.name: Shard Convergence
cases.text: Search your library for a Forest card, an Island card, a Swamp card, and a Mountain card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

cases.name: Shard Convergence
cases.text: Search your library for a Plains card, an Island card, a Swamp card, and a Forest card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

cases.name: Shard Convergence
cases.text: Search your library for a Plains card, an Island card, a Swamp card, and a Mountain card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

cases.name: Suppress
cases.text: Target player exiles all cards from their graveyard face down. At the beginning of the end step of that player's next turn, that player returns those cards to their hand.

cases.name: Suppress
cases.text: Target player exiles all cards from their hand face up. At the beginning of the end step of that player's next turn, that player returns those cards to their hand.

cases.name: Sylvan Awakening
cases.text: Until your next turn, all lands you control become 2/2 Elemental creatures with reach, indestructible, and haste. They're still lands.

cases.name: The End
cases.text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if your life total is 7 or less.
Exile target creature or planeswalker. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that permanent and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.

cases.name: Treasure Hunt
cases.text: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a noncreature card, then put all cards revealed this way into your hand.

cases.name: Vicious Betrayal
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice any number of creatures.
Target creature gets +2/+4 until end of turn for each creature sacrificed this way.

cases.name: Vicious Betrayal
cases.text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice any number of creatures.
Target creature gets +3/+2 until end of turn for each creature sacrificed this way.
